mechanism_claims.claim_text: QS18 has direct source-backed membrane-disruption evidence in C. neoformans from microscopy and membrane-potential assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper supports membrane disruption/depolarization; it does not identify a single molecular target receptor.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: QS18 against Cryptococcus neoformans BNCC 225501 biofilms
mechanism_claims.claim_text: QS18 shows antibiofilm phenotypes and reduced live-cell fluorescence in treated C. neoformans biofilms.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm data support phenotype and cell damage context, not a separate molecular mechanism beyond membrane disruption.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: mouse systemic C. neoformans infection model
mechanism_claims.claim_text: QS18 treatment reduced fungal burden and inflammatory readouts in the mouse infection model.
mechanism_claims.limitations: In vivo efficacy and inflammatory marker changes are not promoted to a direct antimicrobial molecular mechanism.

source_review_summary.overclaim_guard: direct_mechanism is limited to membrane-disruption assays with explicit microscopy/membrane-potential locators.
